clinician.final_diagnosis: Histopathology confirmed leiomyoma with the tissue composed of interweaving bands of bland smooth muscles with no cell atypia.
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 41-year-old female with five months of intermittent right anteromedial thigh pain and urinary frequency/urgency underwent extensive evaluation revealing a 44 × 42 × 28 mm right anterior bladder wall lesion. Imaging (Ultrasound, CT, MRI, FDG-PET CT) demonstrated a heterogeneous, intramural, mobile bladder mass with mild enhancement and low-grade metabolic activity without nodal or distant spread. Urine cytology and culture were negative for infection or malignancy. Intraoperative findings showed an extramural mass adjacent to the right inferolateral bladder wall, which was circumferentially dissected free without partial cystectomy. Histopathology (implied but not directly disclosed) confirmed leiomyoma characterized by interweaving bands of bland smooth muscle cells without atypia.
